summary: Examples of the dict lookup looping over users with item.key and item.value, with_dict on an inline dict, and using item.key in a when condition.
questions: How do I print each user's name and phone from a dict?
How do I use with_dict with an inline dictionary?
Can I use item.key in a when condition when looping a dict?

answer_card.title: dict lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars:
  users:
    alice: {name: Alice Appleworth, telephone: 123-456-7890}
    bob: {name: Bob Bananarama, telephone: 987-654-3210}
tasks:
  - ansible.builtin.debug:
      msg: "User {{ item.key }} is {{ item.value.name }} ({{ item.value.telephone }})"
    loop: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.dict', users) }}"

  - ansible.builtin.debug:
      msg: "{{ item.key }}: {{ item.value }}"
    with_dict: {a: 1, b: 2, c: 3}

  - ansible.builtin.set_fact:
      alice_exists: true
    loop: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.dict', users) }}"
    when: "'alice' in item.key"
```
